extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians and graduate students working in geometric topology and knot theory (readers of arXiv listings)
extracted.subtask_description: Extracting and interpreting bibliographic and abstract-level information for a mathematics research paper (arXiv entry) about left-orderable fundamental groups and Dehn surgeries on twist knots. The page is an arXiv listing providing title, authors, abstract, subject classification, submission history, and withdrawal notice.
